mapper.insert: insert into pilipili.user_action(action_id, video_id, video_user_id, comment_id, action_type, action_count, user_id, action_time) values (#{actionId}, #{videoId}, #{videoUserId}, #{commentId}, #{actionType}, #{actionCount}, #{userId}, #{actionTime});
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(sum(like_count), 0) likeCount, IFNULL(sum(play_count), 0) playCount FROM pilipili.video_info WHERE user_id = #{userId}
